description: This script contains a test suite for adding and editing files in a Git repository, including setup, patch creation, and verification of git commands using shell scripting and Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp for Git commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and verifies they are identical.

methods.name: test_set_editor
methods.description: Sets a custom editor for Git commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the following command fails.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that the previous command exits with the specified code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
